title: Correct acceleration value
description: Essential Criteria: The student's answer for part (1) must be -4 m/s² (or equivalent with correct sign).

title: Correct displacement value
description: Essential Criteria: The student's answer for part (2) must be 40.5 m (or equivalent).

title: Applies kinematic equation
description: Important Criteria: The solution uses the correct kinematic equation (e.g., x = v₀t + ½at²) to find acceleration.

title: Recognizes stopping time
description: Important Criteria: The solution identifies that the car stops before 5 seconds and calculates the stopping time (4.5 s).

title: Uses average velocity for displacement
description: Important Criteria: For part (2), the displacement after stopping is correctly calculated using average velocity over the motion time.

title: Sign error in acceleration
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student incorrectly reports a positive acceleration value instead of negative (deceleration).

title: Displacement after stopping
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student incorrectly calculates displacement for the full 5 seconds, ignoring that the car is stationary after 4.5 s.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: All quantities are expressed with correct SI units (m, s, m/s²) throughout the solution.
